qualityCriteria.scope: Native prototype variant and supplied preview evidence only; no production or Godot integration approval.
technicalLocks: Preserve measured source camera matrix, orthographic projection, pixel aspect and shift. Export native 384x704 frames at sourceScale 2 with logical frame 192x352, logical root [96,248] and cellSize 128.
Use one geometry/material/light setup for N/E/S/W with the declared source facing rotations; no per-view fitting, recoloring, camera adjustment or target-facing art cards.

Use native editable geometry/materials, source lighting family and declared resource closure; preserve original and production bytes.

Final evidence includes exact editable project, all four native facings, four-view sheet, dense real phone edge/corner consumer showing existing decor intermixture, native validation and hash-bound packet.

shapeVolume: A broad asymmetric rockery cluster reads as three interlocking substantial boulder masses, with purposeful low/middle/high crown variation and uneven shoulders, rather than one regular slab, shelf, thin spike or three identical stones.
Large faceted crowns and chamfered irregular edges support believable solid volume; crown, bevel and lower-side planes have clear hierarchy at the fixed steep source camera.

Every facing retains a coherent rockery silhouette and volume, without an unworked flat rear, exposed construction, detached geometry or a materially weaker view. Unseen directions need not duplicate the one target view.
color: The dominant mass is cool dark slate-blue/violet with lighter desaturated blue-violet crown planes and darker side planes. It fits the frozen edge scene and existing prop family.
Green crevice foliage is distinct from the rocks, with lighter leaf faces and darker folds. Neither saturated leaves nor near-black rock sides overwhelm the whole prop.
lightingHighlights: Broad face-to-face value changes clarify the faceted volume while the declared symmetric lighting remains intact.
Highlights remain restrained; side faces retain enough information to avoid large black dead spots. No bloom, conspicuous gloss or blown white accents are needed for this rough faceted style.
materialDetail: Rock detail is carried primarily by large uneven planes and local facet/value variation, with quiet surface treatment that survives reduction without grain noise.

Thick angular folded leaves grow from the rock gaps in two visible crevice clusters, including compact crown-like foliage where useful. Leaves feel attached and volumetric, without a pot or detached decoration; the principal rock masses remain exposed.
Avoid obvious identical repeated leaf spikes, thin paper planes, coplanar artifacts, unsupported intersections or decorative outline halos.
artifactFreeReadability: At logical sprite scale and in the actual phone edge/corner composition, the cluster still reads as cool rocks plus green attached foliage, with staggered crowns and a clear outer silhouette.

In dense repetition beside crates, plants, barrels and lanterns, it contributes contiguous organic edge mass without visual holes, grid-like slab cadence, abrupt chopped contours or apparent floating pieces.
All required images are transparent, unclipped and free of visible unwanted outlines, seam flicker, black crevices that merge whole masses, or stray pixels/geometry.

reviewPriority: Broad staggered boulder volume and silhouette
Cool faceted material hierarchy and attached green foliage
Four-facing and dense phone consumer coherence
acceptancePolicy: Approval requires a perceptually material improvement from the actual plain native slab toward the frozen style, a passing technical capture/asset contract and no material dead spots in required views.
Comparative 1-10 scores summarize visible evidence; no score alone is a pass threshold.
Do not demand target camera drift or exact target pixel geometry. Retain broad cluster identity, coherent material and meaningful phone-scale improvement within the physical envelope.
Missing packaging or technical/consumer proof produces needs_evidence; an actual visual blocker produces revise. At most three ranked material blockers per round.
